notes: C(k) values are numerical Hankel-function evaluations.
The history-integral data uses a two-exponential Wagner approximation.
Flow360 ladder rows are placeholder schema entries, not completed CFD cases.

notes.analogy: A sudden command does not produce full lift instantly; the wake has to catch up.
notes.maths: Uses the common two-exponential Wagner approximation as the time-domain companion to C(k).

notes.analogy: Different oscillations look messy until the wake's delay and attenuation are accounted for.
notes.maths: Dividing by |C(k)| and removing phase aligns the circulatory harmonic response.

notes.analogy: Pitch and plunge both make lift, but they ask the wake different questions.
notes.maths: Components are simplified thin-airfoil phasors: circulatory terms scaled by C(k), added-mass terms kept explicit.

modelLadder.memory: Steady mean-flow state; no resolved motion history.

modelLadder.memory: Time-accurate mean-flow evolution with modeled turbulence.

modelLadder.memory: Large-scale wake structures evolve in the computed flow.
